user_has_login_check.name: user_has_login_check
user_has_login_check.value: "user"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "user"."username" IS NOT NULL

fee_exception_kind_columns_check.name: fee_exception_kind_columns_check
fee_exception_kind_columns_check.value: ("fee_exception"."kind" = 'alternate_option' AND "fee_exception"."alternate_fee_structure_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fee_exception"."discount_type" IS NULL AND "fee_exception"."discount_value" IS NULL) OR ("fee_exception"."kind" = 'discount' AND "fee_exception"."alternate_fee_structure_id" IS NULL AND "fee_exception"."discount_type" IS NOT NULL AND "fee_exception"."discount_type" IN ('percent', 'fixed') AND "fee_exception"."discount_value" IS NOT NULL)

fee_exception_discount_value_check.name: fee_exception_discount_value_check
fee_exception_discount_value_check.value: "fee_exception"."discount_type" IS NULL OR ("fee_exception"."discount_value" IS NOT NULL AND "fee_exception"."discount_value" >= 0 AND ("fee_exception"."discount_type" <> 'percent' OR "fee_exception"."discount_value" <= 100))

fee_exception_ended_check.name: fee_exception_ended_check
fee_exception_ended_check.value: "fee_exception"."ended_by" IS NULL OR "fee_exception"."effective_to" IS NOT NULL

fee_structure_frequency_check.name: fee_structure_frequency_check
fee_structure_frequency_check.value: ("fee_structure"."billing_type" = 'recurring' AND "fee_structure"."frequency" IS NOT NULL AND "fee_structure"."frequency" IN ('monthly', 'per_term')) OR ("fee_structure"."billing_type" = 'one_time_package' AND "fee_structure"."frequency" IS NULL)

fee_structure_intake_needs_course_check.name: fee_structure_intake_needs_course_check
fee_structure_intake_needs_course_check.value: "fee_structure"."intake_id" IS NULL OR "fee_structure"."course_id" IS NOT NULL

invoice_item_content_fields_check.name: invoice_item_content_fields_check
invoice_item_content_fields_check.value: ("invoice_item"."kind" = 'content' AND "invoice_item"."content_purchase_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("invoice_item"."kind" <> 'content' AND "invoice_item"."content_purchase_id" IS NULL)

invoice_item_sign_check.name: invoice_item_sign_check
invoice_item_sign_check.value: ("invoice_item"."kind" IN ('recurring_fee', 'package_fee', 'content') AND "invoice_item"."amount" > 0) OR ("invoice_item"."kind" = 'discount' AND "invoice_item"."amount" < 0) OR ("invoice_item"."kind" = 'adjustment' AND "invoice_item"."amount" <> 0)

invoice_item_recurring_fields_check.name: invoice_item_recurring_fields_check
invoice_item_recurring_fields_check.value: "invoice_item"."kind" <> 'recurring_fee' OR ("invoice_item"."enrollment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_item"."fee_structure_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_item"."period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_item"."period_end" IS NOT NULL)

invoice_item_package_fields_check.name: invoice_item_package_fields_check
invoice_item_package_fields_check.value: "invoice_item"."kind" <> 'package_fee' OR ("invoice_item"."enrollment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_item"."fee_structure_id" IS NOT NULL)

invoice_item_period_check.name: invoice_item_period_check
invoice_item_period_check.value: "invoice_item"."period_start" IS NULL OR "invoice_item"."period_end" IS NULL OR "invoice_item"."period_end" > "invoice_item"."period_start"

payment_bank_reference_uq.name: payment_bank_reference_uq
payment_bank_reference_uq.where: "payment"."bank_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment"."reference_no" IS NOT NULL AND "payment"."status" <> 'rejected'

payment_verified_fields_check.name: payment_verified_fields_check
payment_verified_fields_check.value: "payment"."status" <> 'verified' OR ("payment"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payment"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

payment_voided_fields_check.name: payment_voided_fields_check
payment_voided_fields_check.value: "payment"."status" <> 'voided' OR ("payment"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "payment"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payment"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)

content_item_kind_fields_check.name: content_item_kind_fields_check
content_item_kind_fields_check.value: ("content_item"."kind" = 'recording' AND "content_item"."external_url" IS NOT NULL AND "content_item"."file_id" IS NULL) OR ("content_item"."kind" = 'file' AND "content_item"."file_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("content_item"."kind" = 'physical_book' AND "content_item"."external_url" IS NULL AND "content_item"."file_id" IS NULL)

content_purchase_handover_check.name: content_purchase_handover_check
content_purchase_handover_check.value: ("content_purchase"."handed_over_at" IS NULL AND "content_purchase"."handed_over_by" IS NULL) OR ("content_purchase"."handed_over_at" IS NOT NULL AND "content_purchase"."handed_over_by" IS NOT NULL AND "content_purchase"."status" = 'paid' AND "content_purchase"."channel" = 'physical')

exam_window_check.name: exam_window_check
exam_window_check.value: "exam"."opens_at" IS NULL OR "exam"."closes_at" IS NULL OR "exam"."closes_at" > "exam"."opens_at"

exam_mode_fields_check.name: exam_mode_fields_check
exam_mode_fields_check.value: ("exam"."mode" = 'online_mcq' AND "exam"."opens_at" IS NOT NULL AND "exam"."closes_at" IS NOT NULL AND "exam"."max_attempts" IS NOT NULL) OR ("exam"."mode" = 'paper' AND "exam"."exam_date" IS NOT NULL AND "exam"."max_marks" IS NOT NULL AND "exam"."opens_at" IS NULL AND "exam"."closes_at" IS NULL AND "exam"."time_limit_minutes" IS NULL AND "exam"."max_attempts" IS NULL)

exam_attempt_submitted_check.name: exam_attempt_submitted_check
exam_attempt_submitted_check.value: ("exam_attempt"."status" IN ('submitted', 'graded') AND "exam_attempt"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("exam_attempt"."status" = 'in_progress' AND "exam_attempt"."submitted_at" IS NULL) OR "exam_attempt"."status" = 'expired'

exam_result_source_attempt_check.name: exam_result_source_attempt_check
exam_result_source_attempt_check.value: ("exam_result"."source" = 'attempt' AND "exam_result"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("exam_result"."source" = 'manual' AND "exam_result"."attempt_id" IS NULL) OR "exam_result"."source" = 'manual_override'

commission_entry_type_amounts_check.name: commission_entry_type_amounts_check
commission_entry_type_amounts_check.value: ("commission_entry"."entry_type" = 'accrual' AND "commission_entry"."reverses_entry_id" IS NULL AND "commission_entry"."base_amount" >= 0 AND "commission_entry"."commission_amount" >= 0 AND "commission_entry"."commission_amount" <= "commission_entry"."base_amount") OR ("commission_entry"."entry_type" = 'reversal' AND "commission_entry"."reverses_entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commission_entry"."base_amount" <= 0 AND "commission_entry"."commission_amount" <= 0 AND "commission_entry"."commission_amount" >= "commission_entry"."base_amount")

commission_rule_scope_check.name: commission_rule_scope_check
commission_rule_scope_check.value: ("commission_rule"."course_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commission_rule"."subject_id" IS NULL AND "commission_rule"."grade_level_id" IS NULL) OR ("commission_rule"."course_id" IS NULL AND ("commission_rule"."grade_level_id" IS NULL OR "commission_rule"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL))

teacher_payout_paid_check.name: teacher_payout_paid_check
teacher_payout_paid_check.value: "teacher_payout"."status" <> 'paid' OR ("teacher_payout"."paid_on" IS NOT NULL AND "teacher_payout"."payment_reference" IS NOT NULL)
